description: Rags: used or new, scrap twine, cordage, rope and cables and worn out articles of twine, cordage, rope or cables, of textile materials: sorted
Pig fat: not lard, other than that of heading 0209 or 1503
Vegetable oils: soya-bean oil and its fractions, other than crude, whether or not refined, but not chemically modified
Juice: grapefruit (including pomelo), of a Brix value not exceeding 20, unfermented, (not containing added spirit), whether or not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
Juice: pineapple, of a Brix value not exceeding 20, unfermented, (not containing added spirit), whether or not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
Juice: tomato, unfermented, not containing added spirit, whether or not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
Juice: apple, of a Brix value not exceeding 20, unfermented, (not containing added spirit), whether or not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
Juices: mixtures of fruits or vegetables, unfermented, not containing added spirit, whether or not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
Non-alcoholic beverages: non-alcoholic beer

Cases and containers: handbags (whether or not with shoulder strap and including those without handle), of vulcanised fibre or of paperboard, or wholly or mainly covered with such materials or with paper
Cotton yarn: (not sewing thread), multiple or cabled, of combed fibres, 85% or more by weight of cotton, 192.30 to 125 decitex (53 to 80 metric number) per single yarn, not for retail sale
Fabrics, woven: of jute or of other textile bast fibres of heading no. 5303, other than unbleached

Yarn, synthetic: filament, monofilament (less than 67 decitex), polyesters (not high tenacity or textured), not partially oriented, single, untwisted or twisted 50 turns or less per metre, not for retail sale, not sewing thread
Twine: binder or baler twine, of sisal or other textile fibres of the genus agave
Trousers, bib and brace overalls, breeches and shorts: women's or girls', of cotton (not knitted or crocheted)

Singlets and other vests, briefs, panties, negligees, bathrobes, dressing gowns etc.: women's or girls', of man-made fibres (not knitted or crocheted), excluding incontinence or other sanitary garments or garment liners of heading no. 96.19
Track suits and other garments n.e.c.: women's or girls', of textile materials n.e.c. in item no. 6211.4 (not knitted or crocheted)
Shawls, scarves, mufflers, mantillas, veils and the like: of silk or silk waste (not knitted or crocheted)
Sacks and bags: of a kind used for the packing of goods, of cotton
Bells, gongs and the like: non-electric, of base metal
Statuettes and other ornaments: of base metal plated with precious metal
Musical instruments: string, played with a bow (e.g. violins)
Sculptures and statuary: original, in any material
